data.notes: Confirmed December programming is led by salsa/tropical concerts and New Year’s Eve rooftop parties; many Cartagena club calendars had not yet published full December 2026 lineups.

events.title: Festival de las Antillas Cartagena 2026
events.summary: One-night Caribbean/tropical festival at Plaza de Toros featuring Oscar D’León, Issac Delgado, Alain Pérez, Sergio Vargas, and Jean Carlos Centeno & Ronald Urbina.

events.title: Vueltabajero Salsa Festival 9
events.summary: Ninth edition of Cartagena’s Vueltabajero salsa gathering, listed with Jerry Rivera, Yiyo Sarante, Charlie Aponte, Moncho Rivera, and Daiquiri.

events.title: Caribebeat – Cartagena
events.summary: Electronic, afro and Latin tropical-beats party at Casa Bohême with DJ Miss Champús and DJ José Alvarado confirmed on the bill.

events.title: Fiesta de las Luces 2026 – San Silvestre en Panorámica
events.summary: New Year’s Eve party at Panorámica with live music, Orquesta La Brava, DJ Cost, Fenix, an international DJ, and fireworks overlooking Cartagena.

events.title: Made in Colombia · NYE 2026
events.summary: Mirador Culture Bar’s New Year’s Eve event pairs a globally curated DJ set with a guest orchestra and Colombian-themed performances across rooftop and club spaces.

events.title: Fiesta de Fin de Año – Anandá Hotel Boutique / Vedana
events.summary: New Year’s Eve celebration in the Walled City with live music at Restaurante Vedana and a DJ on the terrace.
